title: Public AI Development Archive
translation_policy: Faithful English translation of the original Japanese prompt and visible AI interaction used during development. No summary, beautification, or added requirements. Code, commands, file paths, URLs, identifiers, and error messages are kept in their original form.
notes: Post-merge fields (pr_number, pr_url, merge_commit, ci_status, post_merge_ci_status) are null at author time. pr_number and pr_url are filled in a follow-up commit on this branch after the PR is opened. merge_commit and post_merge_ci_status stay null unless filled by a later small PR; they are always verifiable via the linked pr_url.
